name: an item a player dropped
source: recording sha256 65fa45c61d4667ff9c23de29a508a246e5224fe538d6779c4ea5c3f2709bbdde, vanilla 26.1.2 server sha256 4723380bd2a0a0206719b50f2e390383afdaf82b0a76a0d573baf788e6aa3e86, 2026-08-18. The arrows were summoned from the server console; the item is one this repository's own client dropped.
because: This is the weakest lane in the set and the bound says so. Every other capture here starts from a position and a motion the operator stated by summoning the entity; this one is an item the client dropped, so its start position is one accumulated from relative moves and its start velocity is one the server stated at a different instant. The two velocities the server reported for the first two ticks differ by 0.056 a tick, which over the fifteen ticks to the ground is eight tenths of a block of ambiguity in where it should land. The trajectory arrives within 0.092 of where the server put it, an order of magnitude inside that; 0.125 is the smallest round number above the measurement rather than anything derived from the wire. A summoned 26.1 item, captured the way the 1.8.9 ones were, would replace this with a lane worth the name.
